name: visualize-pro
description: Self-contained MCP widget renderer for Visualize Pro HTML fragments.

interface.shortDescription: Render offline widget HTML without Visualize's CDN shell.
interface.longDescription: Visualize Pro renders self-contained HTML, CSS, SVG, and JavaScript through its own MCP App resource and provides a loopback preview fallback.
